citation.title: Plasma amino acids vs conventional predictors of insulin resistance measured by the hyperinsulinemic clamp

population.description: Retrospective analysis of 134 men and women pooled from the lab's earlier published clamp studies (refs 11-18; none of them is in this corpus): 51 healthy (29 men, 22 women), 31 nondiabetic overweight/obese, 52 with type 2 diabetes. Only the healthy and Ow/Ob groups are entered, each sex separately with its own printed age and BMI (protocol overrides); no pooled age or BMI is printed. Healthy = BMI <=25 (age <65) or <=29 (age >=65); Ow/Ob = above those cutoffs.

protocols.name: fasted_healthy_men
protocols.description: Short postabsorptive arm for healthy men (Table 1, column Men, Healthy, n = 29): after an overnight fast (hours not stated, 10 assumed), values read at minutes 29-30 (drawn postabsorptive, in the steady state of the tracer infusion before the clamp, so the real fast was at least overnight and its length is not printed); age 53 ± 20 y and BMI 23.3 ± 2.3 kg/m2 as printed in Table 1 (means ± SD, as printed; the age SD is the paper's own, Table 1 footnote 'Data are means ± SD').

protocols.name: fasted_healthy_women
protocols.description: Short postabsorptive arm for healthy women (Table 1, column Women, Healthy, n = 22): after an overnight fast (hours not stated, 10 assumed), values read at minutes 29-30 (drawn postabsorptive, in the steady state of the tracer infusion before the clamp, so the real fast was at least overnight and its length is not printed); age 47 ± 24 y and BMI 22.3 ± 2.4 kg/m2 as printed in Table 1 (means ± SD, as printed; the age SD is the paper's own, Table 1 footnote 'Data are means ± SD').

protocols.description: Short postabsorptive arm for overweight/obese nondiabetic men (Table 1, column Men, Ow/Ob, n = 11): after an overnight fast (hours not stated, 10 assumed), values read at minutes 29-30 (drawn postabsorptive, in the steady state of the tracer infusion before the clamp, so the real fast was at least overnight and its length is not printed); age 45 ± 18 y and BMI 32.2 ± 3.1 kg/m2 as printed in Table 1 (means ± SD, as printed; the age SD is the paper's own, Table 1 footnote 'Data are means ± SD').

protocols.description: Short postabsorptive arm for overweight/obese nondiabetic women (Table 1, column Women, Ow/Ob, n = 20): after an overnight fast (hours not stated, 10 assumed), values read at minutes 29-30 (drawn postabsorptive, in the steady state of the tracer infusion before the clamp, so the real fast was at least overnight and its length is not printed); age 56 ± 19 y and BMI 34.2 ± 4.8 kg/m2 as printed in Table 1 (means ± SD, as printed; the age SD is the paper's own, Table 1 footnote 'Data are means ± SD').
